usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover the available sub-resources under `/cluster/config` (e.g., nodes, totem, join). It is a directory index with no parameters and requires `Sys.Audit` on the root path, so it is readable by any monitoring token with that privilege. Useful as a starting point before calling deeper cluster configuration endpoints.
tips: The returned array contains objects with a `name` field identifying each child resource; follow those names to construct sub-paths like /cluster/config/nodes or /cluster/config/totem.
This endpoint is safe to poll frequently — it is a read-only directory index with no side effects.
